youtube_description:
Jesus... why does my mind get loud the moment I lie down? It's 3 AM again.

It's 3 AM again. He replays every stupid thing he said today, then starts worrying about tomorrow.

Him: Jesus... why does my mind get loud the moment I lie down? It's 3 AM again.

Him: I replay every stupid thing I said today. Then I start worrying about tomorrow.

Jesus: You held everything together all day. At night there's nothing left to distract you, so it all comes out at once.

Him: I've tried everything. Music, no phone, counting. Nothing works.

Jesus: You've been trying to win a fight with your own thoughts. You don't have to win tonight. You can hand them to Me.

Him: And what if the worries are real? What if tomorrow really goes wrong?

Jesus: Then I'll be there tomorrow too. You don't have to stay awake to keep watch. That's My job, not yours.

"When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet."
Proverbs 3:24 (BSB)

Jesus: Put it down. Close your eyes. I've got the night.
